game_title: Flowchart Lab · Count up to n
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on ash wraiths.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Print the whole numbers from 1 through n. If n is zero, print nothing. Test dataset 7: {'n': 0}; {'n': 12}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Cinder Cone Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the cooling vent using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 19.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the cooling vent is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Arithmetic Cannon – Cinder Cone Camp Trial
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
